summary: Lofi bass: a warm, round, sustained Cubed with the squelch taken out, the producer's default lofi bass
body: The producer's lofi bass (2026-11-27: 'low attack, smooth sustained warm sound', the early lofi sessions' bass, not a finger or fretless one): openDAW's Cubed (303-style) on a sawtooth with its filter nearly closed, almost no resonance or envelope, a soft accent, so the acid squelch is gone and a round, sustained low end is left; a low-pass around 600 Hz on top. Long notes on the chord roots and fifths.
Register: MIDI 33-57 (openDAW names C3 = 60). A bass already on a Cubed gets these settings (set_param on its instrument) instead of a new track.

track.about: a Cubed track to set so; leave out for a new track
